The warning no longer holds the only copy: a revising write now PRESERVES a replaced value that nothing else holds, before computing the note, so the note is a receipt in that case rather than a regret.

⚠️ ITS LAST PARAGRAPH IS NOT RETIRED AND SHOULD NOT BE READ AS SUCH. bhome's separate complaint — a refused bulk write discarding a ~4 KB body, and "no way to say 'change this one thing' on a large node" — is a different gap and remains open under `dec:idea-should-a-large-node-be-changeable-one-field-at-a-time`, which Anthony accepted the same day with only the snapshot half built.

📌 The fact's own sequencing argument is what decided the design: a rule resting on call ORDER can be broken by an agent host without either party choosing to, so the guarantee moved inside the write.
